basis: Independent additional2mm bottom-strip expansion to51.2x39.5mm after actual zero-unconnected quiet-routing trial07 with dedicated R7.2 star. Numeric2/.3mm targets unchanged. Both33mm and37.5mm checkpoints preserved; no global infeasibility claim or exact-source human acceptance.

blocks.basis: PI LinkSwitch-TN2 high-side buck and layout guidance; TI SLYP762 switched-current and Kelvin routing principles.

sensitive_nets.rationale: Keep BP/FB local to U1 and quiet references away from SW and coil projections; all remain mains referenced.

switching_nodes.rationale: Minimize the commutating copper envelope; the mandatory DPAK cathode tab is included, not omitted.

return_paths.rationale: Separate force return from current-reference Kelvin branch; no switch-current flow in the reference spur.

loops.rationale: Keep the input commutation loop compact, then the output/freewheel loop. Review actual routed geometry, not only DRC.

kelvin_connections.rationale: Separate sense pickup at the resistor lands from LED and power-return force routes.

not_automated_by_empty_areas: Empty fixed-area inventory does not assert that under-coil sensitive routes or under-can copper are acceptable. Those manufacturer/assembly restrictions must be checked separately against final placement.
